meta.title: Reply notifier
meta.description: When an agent reply finishes, or a permission prompt, plan review, or question waits for your input, a reminder names the session and can open it. While you watch it is a corner card; when you are away (hidden, unfocused, or idle) it is a top alert with a persistent system notification and a few repeating chimes (two repeats, then silence). Coming back to the window clears it, and any click or keystroke in the window clears every reminder at once — the top seat is never used while the window is in front. The session list marks the session that waits for your reply with a red dot until you open it, click in it, or the session runs again; a waiting prompt keeps the harness's own status dot. In DeepSeek Harness Desktop the taskbar entry also blinks three times, about a second each, and behind another window stays highlighted until you activate the harness. Reading status only: it never answers a prompt. Options live on the reply-notifier row in the profile's cordis.patch.yml; the plugin switch turns every reminder off.
